c74object.name: evi.transratio
c74object.digest: Convert semitones to pitch and vica versa
c74object.description: Like the [transratio] abstraction but with multiple choices for input/output conversion.

inlet.digest: Input in either pitch, octave, semitones, cents or ratio
inlet.description: Set the input type with the @in attribute or the first argument to the object. (bang) retriggers the last used inlet value.

outlet.digest: Output value in either ratio, semitones, hz or pitch
outlet.description: Set the output type with the @out attribute or the second argument to the object.

attribute.name: base
attribute.description: Set the tuning for the conversion around A = 440.

attribute.name: in
attribute.description: symbol, one of: pitch, octave, semitones, cents, ratio. Sets the input to the convertor.

attribute.name: init
attribute.description: Init 1 will trigger a conversion of 0. and output on load. Quite pointless.

attribute.name: offset
attribute.description: Hz and pitch convert assuming middle C = 60. Via @offset you can change this to anything you need.

attribute.name: out
attribute.description: symbol, one of: ratio, semitones, hz, pitch. Sets the output from the convertor.
